title: CountEx: Fine-Grained Counting via Exemplars and Exclusion
authors: Yifeng Huang, Gia Khanh Nguyen, Minh Hoai
abstract: A counting framework where users specify both what to count and what to exclude, using text and optional visual exemplars. Introduces the CoCount benchmark for fine-grained counting.

title: Can Current AI Models Count What We Mean, Not What They See? A Benchmark and Systematic Evaluation
authors: Gia Khanh Nguyen, Yifeng Huang, Minh Hoai
abstract: Introduces PairTally, a benchmark of 681 images for fine-grained, intent-driven visual counting.
